texts.facts: Judgment: 1. The present is a complaint filed under section 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 (herein after referred to as Pfa Act), alleging that the accused persons have violated the provisi ons of the PFA Act and Rules . 2. As per the complaint, on 09.06.2004, the Food Inspector (herein after referred to as FI) FI Shri S.P. Singh and FI Shri Mittrapal under the supervision of Local Health Authority (herein after referred to as LHA)/SDM) Shri V.P. Singh visited the premises of M/s Pandit Trading Co., Shop No. 45/1, Parwana Road, Khureji, Delhi- 51, where accused Ram Kumar @ Ram Chander was found conducting the business of food articles for sale for human consumption, including "Refined Soyabean oil", which was lying in sealed tan. The FI disclosed his identity and expressed his intention to purchase a sample of "Refined Soyabean oil" from the vendor for analysis. The sample consisted of 750 gms. of "Refined Soyabean Oil" (ready for sale) taken from a sealed tin of 15 litre, bearing label declaration. The sample was taken under DA vs Ram Kumar @ Ram Chander & Ors the supervision/direction of Sh. V.P. Singh, SDM/LHA. Before taking sample whole contents of the tin was properly mixed by shaking the tin then a hole was made in one corner of tin. The Food Inspector divided the sample into three equal parts then and there by putting into three clean and dry glass bottles. Each sample bottle was separately packed, fastened and sealed according to PFA Act & Rules. The vendor's signatures were obtained on the LHA slip and wrapper of the sample bottles. Notice was given to accused No. 1 Ram Kumar @ Ram Chander and the price of sample was also given to him vide vendor receipt dated 09-06-2004. Panchnama too was prepared at the spot. All the documents prepared by F.l. were signed by accused No. 1 Ram Kumar @ Ram Chander and the other witness Sh. Mittar Pal, FA. Before starting sample proceedings efforts were made to join public witnesses but none came forward, as such Sh. Mittar Pal, FA was joined as witness. 3. One counter-part of the sample was also sent to Public Analyst, Delhi bearing LHA Code Number 22/LHA/6069 in intact condition and two counter-parts were deposited with the SDM/LHA in intact conditions. Public Analyst analysed the sample and found the sample to be nonconforming. The report of Public Analyst is as follows: "The sample does not conform to standard of Refined Soyabean Oil. The sample is of Refined Mustard Oil instead of Refined Soyabean Oil." 4. It is the case of the complainant that the accused No. 1 Ram DA vs Ram Kumar @ Ram Chander & Ors Kumar @ Ram Chander was the vendor of M/s Pandit Trading Co., Shop No. 45/1, Parwana Road, Khureji, Delhi 51 at the time of sampling. M/s Pandit Trading Co. is a proprietorship concern Da vs Ram Kumar @ Ram Chander & Ors on 16 April, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/4302232/ 2 in the name of accused No. 2 Pandit Daya Nand Prasad and as such both the vendor and the proprietor are incharge of and responsible for day to day conduct of the business of the said shop. 5. It is further stated that the vendor had purchased the sampled food article from accused M/s Mahadev Overseas, Shop No. 11811, East Moti bagh, Delhi. M/s Mahadev Overseas is a proprietorship concern in the name of accused No. 3 Surinder Kumar Bhardwaj and he is incharge of and responsible for day to day conduct of the business of the said shop. 6. It is further stated that the sample food article was manufactured and supplied to M/s Mahadev Overseas by M/s Kundan Edible Products Ltd., Plot No.1, RIICO Industrial Area, Khushkhera, Bhiwadi, District Alwar, Rajasthan. M/s Kundan Edible Products Ltd has appointed accused No 5 Sanjeev Rawal as its nominee under PFA Act and Rules and he is incharge of and responsible for day to day conduct of the business of the said firm. Being a company accused No. 4 M/s Kundan Edible Products Ltd is also liable. 7. Thereafter on completion of investigation, sanction under section 20 of the PFA Act was obtained from the Director PFA. The complaint was then filed in the Court on 20.04.2005 alleging DA vs Ram Kumar @ Ram Chander & Ors violation of section 2 (ia) (a) & (m) of PFA Rules, which is punishable under Section 16(1)(a) read with Section 7 of the PFA Act, 1954 by the accused. 8. As the complaint was filed in writing by a public servant, recording of pre-summoning evidence was dispensed with and the accused was summoned vide order dated 20.04.2005. Based on the report of the PA notice was framed against the accused for commission of the offence punishable under section 7/16(1)(a) PFA Act being violation of Section 2(ia)(a)&(m) of PFA Act to which accused pleaded not guilty and claimed trial. During the trial, vide order dated 13.01.2010, the accused No. 3 Surinder Kumar Bhardwaj was declared proclaimed offender and proceedings against the accused No.2 were abated vide order dated 11.08.2016. 9. At the trial, the prosecution examined three witness in support of its case i.e. PW-1 FI S.P. Singh, PW-2 SDM/LHA Sh V.P. Singh and PW-3 FA Mittrapal. PW-1 and PW-2 were part of the team that had visited the spot for sample proceedings under the supervision of SDM/LHA Sh V.P. Singh. These witness narrated the steps undertaken by them during the sample proceedings, including disclosing their identity, expressing intention to purchase sample for analysis, lifting the sample of 750 gms of "Refined Soyabean oil" from sealed tin after opening the sealed tin from the vendor for analysis having label identical declaration, dividing the sample into three counterparts by putting into three clean and dry bottles, separately sealing, packing and marking the same and obtaining signatures of vendor and witnesses. They also DA vs Ram Kumar @ Ram Chander & Ors proved the necessary documents including the vendor's receipt Ex.PW-1/A, Notice Ex.PW-1/B, Panchnama Ex.PW-1/C. Thereafter, on 10.06.2004 one counterpart alongwith copy of memo VII and one more copy of form VII in intact condition were deposited with PA for analysis vide receipt Ex.PW1/D and remaining two counterpart of the sample were deposited with LHA vide LHA receipt Ex.PW1/E. Thereafter, PA Report Ex.PW-1/F was received according to which the sample does not conform to standard. During investigation, vendor furnished statement Ex.PW1/G stating that he purchased the sealed tin of which the sample was lifted from M/s Mahadev Overseas, East Moti Bagh, Sarai, Da vs Ram Kumar @ Ram Chander & Ors on 16 April, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/4302232/ 3 Rohilla vide Bill No. 92 dated 8.6.04. Vendor also gave reply Ex. PW1/G1 in respect of source of purchase. Vendor also gave the photocopy of Bill mark 'X'. Thereafter PW-1 S.P. Singh also sent a letter Ex.PW1/H to STO Ward No. 81 and as per reply at portion A, Daya Nand was found proprietor of M/s Pandit Trading Company. PW-1 also sent a letter Ex.PW1/l to M/s Mahadev Overseas and received reply Ex.PW1/l1 alongwith photocopy of Sales Tax Registration and Bill of purchase of 'Kundan Edible Products Ltd'. Mark-Y. PW-1 also sent a letter Ex. PW1/J to STO Ward No. 41 and as per reply at portion A, Sh Surender Kumar and Govind Sharma were partners of the firm of M/s Mahadev Overseas. PW-1 also received reply Ex.PW1/K from M/s Kundan Edible Products Ltd alongwith certificate of registration and copy of Form-Vlll in favour of Sh. Sanjeev Rawal as their nominee Ex. PW1/K1. PW-1 also got confirmed from CMO, Alwar in respect of nomination of 'Kundan Edible Products Ltd' and as per reply Ex. PW1/K2, accused Sanleev Rawal was DA vs Ram Kumar @ Ram Chander & Ors Nominee of the company. After completion of the investigation, the complete case file along with all the statutory documents were sent to the then Director Sh. Duwab Cgabd through LHA, who after going through the entire case file, applied his mind and gave the sanction for prosecution Ex.PW1/L against the accused person. Thereafter the present complaint Ex.PW1/M was filed in the Court and then the intimation letter Ex.PW1/N was sent along with the PA report by registered post Ex.PW1/O to accused. The witnesses were duly cross examined by the Ld Defence counsel. 10. Statement of the accused under section 313 CrPC were recorded on 22.07.2013 wherein the accused denied the allegations and pleaded innocence. Thereafter the accused did not lead defence and vide order dated 08.10.2013, defence evidence was closed and the matter was fixed for final arguments.
